articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Why Okta (OKTA) Is Up 6.3% After Raymond James’ AI-Focused Upgrade And Profitability Push. Earlier this week, Raymond James upgraded Okta to Outperform, highlighting the identity software firm's improving profitability, strong free cash flow and the expected easing of pandemic-era contract headwinds over the next three years. The broker also argued that the rise of AI agents could materially expand Okta’s addressable market, positioning its identity platform as a key enabler of secure machine-to-machine and human-to-machine interactions.
